20*4.0 Fat tire -off all roads
Ultimate Grip & Stability: The 4-inch wide footprint provides maximum traction on sand, snow, mud, and gravel, ensuring a stable ride where standard tires fail.
Superior Shock Absorption: The high-volume rubber acts as a secondary suspension, soaking up bumps and vibrations for that "riding on a cloud" feel.
Precision Braking Mastery:Equipped with high-performance hydraulic disc brakes, this moped-style e-bike provides rapid response and exceptional stopping power. Whether you're navigating steep descents or city traffic, enjoy total control and a safer ride on any terrain.
Superior Hydraulic Stopping Power:Engineered for maximum safety, our high-performance hydraulic disc brakes deliver consistent, reliable braking in all weather conditions. Experience the confidence of responsive stopping power that matches the UM1 PRO’s incredible speed and agility.
Smart Control Center&NFC Unlock: Your High-Tech Cockpi
Instant NFC Access: Ditch the keys and start your adventure in just 1 second. With two encrypted NFC cards included, unlocking your e-bike is as simple as a single tap—secure, convenient, and time-saving.
Full-Color Data Hub: Keep track of your real-time riding data at a glance on the smart LCD display. Whether it’s speed, mileage, battery life, or riding mode, everything remains crystal clear even under direct sunlight.
Customized Performance: Effortlessly toggle between 5 Intelligent PAS levels to match your terrain, or use the One-Touch Cruise Control to lock in your speed and enjoy a relaxed glide on long stretches.
Dual-Suspension Mastery；Active Horst-Link Geometry
All-Terrain Dominance:Experience a "floating" sensation with our advanced dual-suspension system. The high-responseHydraulic Front Forkcombined with the
Rear Horst-linksetup works in perfect synergy to neutralize heavy impacts, ensuring a smooth, controlled ride on even the most rugged terrain.
Uncompromised Stability:Experience a ride where braking never interferes with your comfort. By separating braking from suspension action, this system keeps your rear wheel stable and engaged with the trail, giving you the confidence to master the steepest descents with total precision.
UL 2849 Certified & 48V 33Ah Removable Battery
Certified Power for Endless Exploration:At the heart of the ride is a high-performance 48V 33Ah battery, engineered for both endurance and peace of mind. Experience up to100 milesof exploration, backed by the industry-leadingUL 2849 safety certification. Its intelligentBMS protectionand all-weather waterproof design provide a reliable, convenient power source that’s as easy to charge as it is to ride.
Unrivaled Speed & Torque: Experience the rush of a 3000W Peak (1200W Rated) motor that propels you to a blistering 28 MPH top speed.
Conquer the Incline: Say goodbye to walking your bike—our high-torque engineering allows you to crush 35° steep slopes effortlessly.
Precision Control: Whether you're navigating high-speed straights or technical climbs, the UM1 PRO delivers consistent, hair-raising performance every time.
Zero Boundaries: From city asphalt and beach sands to gravel paths, snow, and rugged mountain trails, this bike is built to dominate all terrains.
The Ultimate Hybrid: Seamlessly transition from an efficient daily commuter to a high-adrenaline off-road explorer.
